source.title: Wikipedia: Baume scale
source.gives: Developed by Antoine Baume 1768; a pair of hydrometer scales, heavy and light liquids, water 0; heavy degrees were percent NaCl by mass at 60 F; vague instructions gave a large margin of error; precision otherwise open
